summary.text: Michele Brooks is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, representing District 50 since December 1, 2014, after serving in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 2007 to 2014; she is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Sue Mulvey.

paragraphs.text: Michele Brooks served on the Jamestown Borough Council from 1996 to 2002, served on the Mercer County Board of Commissioners, and represented District 17 in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 2007 to 2014.
Her professional experience includes being co-founder and vice president of the Jamestown Future Foundation, and she graduated from the Anne Anstine Excellence in Public Services Series.

For 2025 and 2026 Brooks chaired the Health and Human Services Committee and was vice chair of the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee, with additional assignments to the Rules and Executive Nominations, Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness, and Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure committees.
